topics.title: Stern Discusses Aaron’s Claims
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses a phone call regarding actor Chevy Chase and actress Aaron Moran’s allegations of sexual harassment involving Happy Days cast members Henry Winkler and Scott Baio, as reported by The Inquirer. Stern expresses disbelief about the details revealed and questions their motivations.

topics.title: Radio Show Discussion on Simmons
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss an article speculating about Richard Simmons’s lack of romantic relationships and sexual activity due to his loneliness and past struggles. They delve into details from a purported outtake tape showcasing Simmons's colorful language and behavior, including instances of cursing and interactions with women.

topics.title: Listener Mail: Uncle Ed and Poop Money
topics.summary: During an on-air discussion, hosts explored a disturbing listener mail story involving a man named uncle ed who solicited payments from individuals to urinate in a potty chair. The conversation detailed the bizarre arrangement—including dietary requests for the recipient—and its ongoing nature over several years, highlighting unusual financial transactions and unsettling behavior.
